package.name: nros_px4_tools
package.description:
The `px4` command (RFC-0119 D8): `nros px4 msgs` generates `px4_msgs` (a Rust crate for the XRCE companion, or C++ headers for an in-firmware module) from a PX4-Autopilot `.msg` tree. It replaces the built-in `nros generate-px4-msgs`, which stays as a hidden alias that executes this package.
A command package of the same shape as a user's: the announcement below is what the provider scan reads, and `nros-command.toml` is read only when this provider is the one selected.
